mathematical_result.statement: If disjoint original-coordinate blocks I0,J0 of size 3+r have s_{3+r}(A0[I0,J0])>=sigma, and A=A0+R+S with symmetric rank(R)<=r and ||S||op<=delta<sigma, then every independent cap-one product source gives a continuous density with ||p||infinity <= 3*binom(3+r,3)^(1/3)/(sigma-delta).
mathematical_result.rank_sharp_barrier: The threshold 3+r is rank-sharp for persistence of three mixed directions: a hyperbolic (2+r)-packet plus a rank-r spectral sign-flip perturbation leaves the full spectrum at modulus sigma but reduces the packet cross rank to 2.

partner_applied.scope: Refutes universal E_Z ||p_{Y|Z}||infinity^(2/3) after conditioning on the full spectral complement; does not refute QFORM.

analytic_dependency.scope: For a physical invertible m x m cross block with m>=3, arbitrary same-side curvature/outside couplings are absorbed and ||p||infinity <= m/(m-2)|det B|^{-1/m}.

later_owner_update: Revision 2026-09-22.11 makes scalar conditioning on Q_rest the highest-value common target and declares full spectral-complement conditioning and universal L1 characteristic-function control dead ends. The proved mixed-packet theorem remains a compatible supporting branch but does not close that scalar-conditioned implication.
unresolved_implication: Prove a universal bound on sup_b ||p_{Q3 | Q_rest=b}||infinity, or route the bare three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis into a paid original-coordinate branch without reciprocal diffuse-minor loss.
next_step: Test whether redundant physical mixed packets can be combined with scalar Q_rest conditioning before local determinant selection; otherwise construct a source-valid target-class obstruction to that specific reduction.
